parameters.name: AppStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of client statuses.

parameters.name: AppVersions
parameters.description: The collection of client versions.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The department to which the user belongs. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: DeviceBelong
parameters.description:
The ownership of the endpoint device. Valid values:
- **Personal**: personal device.
- **Company**: company device.

parameters.name: DeviceGroupId
parameters.description: The device group ID.

parameters.name: DeviceStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of endpoint device statuses.

parameters.name: DeviceTags
parameters.description: The collection of endpoint device IDs.

parameters.name: DeviceTypes
parameters.description: The collection of endpoint device operating system types.

parameters.name: DlpStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of office data protection statuses.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The name of the endpoint device. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you enter only an underscore (\_), endpoint devices whose names contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters are also queried.

parameters.name: IaStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of Internet access statuses.

parameters.name: InnerIp
parameters.description: The internal IP address of the endpoint device.

parameters.name: Mac
parameters.description: The MAC address of the endpoint device.

parameters.name: NacStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of network access control statuses.

parameters.name: PaStatuses
parameters.description: The collection of private access statuses.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Settings: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The user ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user endpoint devices.

parameters.name: SharingStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether sharing is enabled for the device. Valid values:
- **true**: Sharing is enabled.
- **false**: Sharing is disabled.

parameters.name: SnBios
parameters.description: The BIOS system serial number.

parameters.name: SnSystem
parameters.description: The system serial number.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort parameter. Valid values:
- **Username**: sorted by Username in ascending order.
- **AppVersion**: sorted by AppVersion in descending order.
- **UpdateTime**: sorted by UpdateTime in descending order.
- **CreateTime**: sorted by CreateTime in descending order.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: Workshop
parameters.description: The name of the office area.
